wiki_hint: Mini contains introductions and may omit details. Full articles are optional. Sizes vary. Downloads resume; existing archives are reused.
web_enabled: Allow web search and reading pages
connections_hint: Weather connects only when requested. Offline mode blocks online requests; weather may then use reports cached during the last 3 days. Web search, online Wikipedia and MCP remain separate and off by default.
wiki_online_enabled: Allow online Wikipedia (separate from web search)
wiki_unavailable: Offline Wikipedia unavailable; tool automatically disabled. Optionally enable online Wikipedia or retry the download later.
hide_chat_destinations: Hide links and file paths in chat
offline_mode: Offline mode – no online tool requests
weather_offline: Weather: live online data are currently unavailable.
weather_no_cache: No matching regional reports from the last 3 days are available.
image_gpu_ready: Image GPU runtime installed. DirectML selected; GPU index 0 is the default adapter.
